channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Marble Cognition raises $3.75M pre-seed for AI coworkers that learn jobs by watching employees work
item.description: Marble Cognition raised $3.75M to build AI coworkers that learn how a company works by watching employees do their jobs.

item.title: Roleo raises €2.9M for a personal AI career agent for tech professionals
item.description: Roleo raised €2.9M for a personal AI career agent that finds tech jobs matching a user's experience, goals and salary expectations.

item.title: XRP Ledger AI payments near 15 million, but total value settled stays under $50,000
item.description: AI-agent payments on the XRP Ledger are nearing 15 million, though total value settled is still under $50,000 — about a third of a cent each.

item.title: Apple Intelligence launches in China in December powered by Alibaba's Qwen; iOS 27.3 dev beta November 4
item.description: Apple Intelligence arrives in China this December powered by Alibaba's Qwen models, with the iOS 27.3 developer beta starting November 4.

item.title: Litera integrates Box into its Lito legal AI agent over MCP
item.description: Litera connected its Lito legal AI agent to Box over MCP, so lawyers can search and summarize Box documents inside their workflow.

item.title: Microsoft Agent Framework October 2026: Python 1.24, .NET 1.25, Harness agent, Go preview; AutoGen archived
item.description: Microsoft's Agent Framework reached Python 1.24 and .NET 1.25 in October, adding a Harness agent and Go preview as AutoGen is archived.

item.title: Fortinet launches FortiGuard Inline AI Security for FortiGate firewalls
item.description: Fortinet added inline AI security to FortiGate firewalls, inspecting prompts, responses and MCP tool calls and flagging 35 types of sensitive data.

item.description: DeepSeek open-sourced Super-Agent, a proactive coding agent that watches developer chats and suggests fixes, alongside a reported $15 billion funding round ahead of a planned IPO.

item.title: x402 passes ~196M cumulative payments settled, $42.3M in volume, as of Nov 1
item.description: A live tracker counts nearly 196 million x402 payments settled and $42.3 million in volume as of November 1, with Base the largest chain.

item.title: Zyrix launches ATLAS, an agent testing platform that issues an evidence-backed Go/No-Go before agents ship
item.description: Zyrix launched ATLAS, a testing platform that checks what AI agents actually do and gives teams an evidence-backed go or no-go before they ship.

item.title: Nov 1 builder roundup ranks Base44 top for a backend without configuring one
item.description: A November 1 roundup ranks Base44 top for non-coders wanting a full app backend without configuring one, with a free tier of 25 message credits a month.

item.title: Causa Prima raises $20M seed to put AI agents on both sides of every invoice
item.description: Causa Prima raised $20M to put AI agents on both sides of every invoice, targeting inter-company settlement for businesses.

item.title: Phinity Labs raises $5.2M seed to build AI agents that design chips from text prompts
item.description: Phinity Labs raised $5.2M to build AI agents that design computer chips from text prompts.

item.title: Instinct reportedly raising at a ~$30B valuation, per investor disclosures
item.description: Instinct is reportedly raising a new round at a valuation of about $30 billion, up from $10 billion in September — unconfirmed by the company.

item.title: State of MCP: October 2026 — 31 security advisories, 52,141 registry servers, spec unchanged until March 2027
item.description: A new State of MCP report counted 31 security advisories in October and over 52,000 servers in the official registry.

item.title: Shopify moves its AI agent knowledge base into Merchant Admin, retires standalone app Jan 15, 2027
item.description: Shopify moved its AI agent knowledge base into Merchant Admin, with the old standalone app retiring January 15, 2027.

item.title: Dataline raises $10.6M to give AI agents data they can trust
item.description: Dataline raised $10.6M to build a marketplace where AI agents pay per call for data, with free access for builders on Base and Robinhood Chain.

item.title: OpenAI Python SDK 3.42.0 adds agent context compaction controls
item.description: OpenAI's Python SDK 3.42.0 adds agent context compaction controls, session review, and experimental time awareness for agent builders.

item.title: Factory Droid 1.0: model-independent coding agent harness built on Script mode
item.description: Factory shipped Droid 1.0, a model-independent coding agent harness where the model writes a program to run its tools instead of calling them one by one.

item.title: Who actually pays on x402? An on-chain trace of Base sellers
item.description: An on-chain trace found 52 of 81 sampled x402 sellers earned nothing in 24 hours, with the best earning just $6-15 a day.

item.title: Instinct adds OpenTable booking, its 4th named integration in about 4 days
item.description: Instinct added OpenTable booking, its fourth named integration in about four days after Stripe Link, Shopify Shop Pay and 1Password.

item.title: AI Agent Framework Leaderboard updated Oct 31: Dify first of 43 open-source frameworks
item.description: Dify leads a new ranking of 43 open-source AI agent frameworks, ahead of n8n and Mastra, with 30 of the 43 shipping a release in the last month.

item.title: XRPL passes 14.5 million AI-agent x402 micro-payments, but only ~$33,500 settled
item.description: AI agents have now made over 14.5 million x402 micro-payments on the XRP Ledger, though total settlement is only about $33,500 so far.

item.title: OpenAI cuts funding target by $10B amid tech rout, FT reports
item.description: OpenAI reportedly cut its latest funding target by $10 billion to about $20 billion, with its valuation dropping to around $1.25 trillion, per the Financial Times.

item.title: OpenAI releases GPT-Rosalind-6 for approved biology researchers
item.description: OpenAI released GPT-Rosalind-6, a life-sciences AI model for approved research labs, priced at $15 per million input tokens.

item.title: CopperPilot raises $390,000 pre-seed for an AI design agent for electronics hardware
item.description: CopperPilot raised $390,000 to build an AI agent that turns plain-English descriptions into manufacturing-ready circuit-board designs.

item.title: Zest launches a personal AI restaurant concierge over text messages
item.description: Zest launched an AI restaurant concierge over text messages that recommends places and books through OpenTable, Resy or SevenRooms.
